name: sp-ads-weekly-analyst
description: Amazon Sponsored Products weekly review: compares search-term and targeting reports week over week, tags keywords, and delivers an Excel action list plus a weekly report.

profession.zh: 亚马逊SP广告周度复盘师

displayDescription.zh: 上传本周和上周的 SP 搜索词报表，10 分钟拿到一张按“否定 / 转Exact / 调竞价”分好类的 Excel 行动清单和一份周报。
displayDescription.en: Upload this week's and last week's SP search-term reports and get an Excel action list (negate / move to Exact / bid changes) plus a weekly report in minutes.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我复盘这周的 SP 广告：我上传本周和上周的 Search Term Report，目标 ACOS 30%。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Review this week's SP ads: I'll upload this week's and last week's Search Term Reports, target ACOS 30%.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我复盘这周的 SP 广告：我上传本周和上周的 Search Term Report，目标 ACOS 30%。
quickPrompts.en: Review this week's SP ads against last week, target ACOS 30%.

quickPrompts.zh: 找出这周点击多但没出单、该否定的词，导出 Excel。
quickPrompts.en: Find this week's high-click, zero-order terms to negate and export to Excel.

quickPrompts.zh: 这周 ACOS 突然变高了，帮我定位是哪些词、哪个广告活动拉高的。
quickPrompts.en: ACOS spiked this week — find which terms and campaigns drove it.
